description.zh: 指定List操作需要从此token开始。您可从ListBucketInventory结果中的NextContinuationToken获取此token。
description.en: The token from which the List operation must start. You can obtain this token from the NextContinuationToken in the ListBucketInventory response.

title.zh: 批量获取存储空间的所有清单任务
title.en: List all inventory rules of a bucket

descriptions.zh:
- 单次请求最多可获取100条清单配置项内容。若需获取超过100条清单配置项，则需发送多次请求，并保留相应的token，作为下一次请求的参数。

- 调用该请求时，请确保您有足够的权限对存储空间的清单任务进行操作。存储空间所有者默认拥有该权限，若您无该项权限，请先向存储空间所有者申请该项操作的权限。
descriptions.en:
- A single request returns up to 100 inventory configuration items. To retrieve more than 100 inventory configuration items, send multiple requests and retain the corresponding token as a parameter for the next request.

- Before calling this operation, make sure that you have sufficient permissions to manage inventory rules for the bucket. The bucket owner has this permission by default. If you do not have this permission, request it from the bucket owner.
